item.title: Israel and Hezbollah continue attacks after Israel-Lebanon talks in US
item.summary: Israel strikes hit southern Lebanon and Hezbollah fires rockets at Israel, a day after rare direct negotiations.

item.title: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
item.summary: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

item.title: Hamas rejects Gaza disarmament plan, Palestinian official says
item.summary: The official tells the BBC that the armed group will not move forward with talks until Israel fully complies with its commitments.

item.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades
item.summary: Organisations warn many more people could be executed in the wake of the anti-government protests which swept Iran earlier this year.

item.title: French cement giant guilty of financing IS and other militant groups in Syria
item.summary: The French company paid $6.5m to jihadist groups to keep its plant running in war-torn Syria, a Paris court heard.

item.title: Israel steps up strikes on Lebanon and Hezbollah attacks continue as talks loom
item.summary: More than 160 people have been killed since Friday in Lebanon, where Israel is pressing on with its campaign against Hezbollah despite the US-Iran ceasefire.

item.title: Starmer says UK will not join Trump's blockade of Iran's ports
item.summary: UK minesweepers and anti-drone capabilities will continue operating in the region, as pressure ramps up to reopen the key shipping route.

item.title: Israelis war-weary but most oppose Iran ceasefire, poll suggests
item.summary: The vast majority did not believe Hezbollah or Iran had been severely weakened by weeks of Israeli and US attacks, according to the poll.

item.title: The US blockade of Iran is a gamble. Will it work?
item.summary: The US military is gambling on the blockade denying Iran vital trade - but questions remain on whether the bet will pay off.

item.title: Concerns after satellite provider restricts Iran images following US pressure
item.summary: Planet Labs says it is restricting coverage of Iran and parts of the Middle East indefinitely.
